author: Sacha Vital
content: I can't fault Dancing Cubs at all. From start to finish the service was fantastic!! Prompt, personal and informative email contact; the play equipment was delivered and collected on time, clean and in great condition. We were even provided anti-bac spray to be able to wipe down the equipment throughout the day if needed. I will 10000000% hire their equipment again and recommend to all my friends. :-)
